name: Desktop
description: See what the user is doing right now. clipboard returns whatever they last copied, active_window says which application is in front and what it is showing, and copy puts text on their clipboard. Check active_window when a request is ambiguous — the same question means something different in a code editor than in a music player. Use clipboard rather than asking them to paste something again.
